note: Gate suites that read source text and never run it. Text can stay green after the behaviour it describes breaks, so each one is declared: structure (the repository's own shape), style (layout, contrast, copy), twin (a named suite that runs the same behaviour), or unbacked. Unbacked only goes down: make the suite run the code, then KIWI_UPDATE_SOURCE_BASELINE=1. Checked by tools/source-assertion-ratchet-test.mjs.
